central_rq: Does user trust track actual explanation correctness, or merely how fluent/confident the explanation sounds?

prerequisite.stimulus_bank_role: Frozen controlled Track-2 correct-vs-incorrect explanation stimuli; not an actual-LLM-performance claim.

items.text: How much do you trust this explanation to support the decision?

trust_measure.notes: Morten must replace/finalize this provisional pilot item with the validated trust measure before design freeze.

power_calculation.notes: Starting recruitment range is 30-40 participants; Morten must finalize the power calculation and required completed N.

ethics.notes: Set according to the applicable institutional ethics determination before FINAL data collection.

participant_materials.instructions: You will see a sequence of AI-generated or AI-style explanations. Evaluate each explanation independently using the information shown. Do not try to infer the hidden study condition.
participant_materials.consent_text: DRAFT FOR PILOT ONLY. Replace this text with the finalized participant information and consent language approved for the study before FINAL recruitment.

analysis_plan.primary_estimand: Within-participant mean trust(correct) minus mean trust(incorrect).
analysis_plan.undertrust_definition: Overriding or rejecting a known-correct explanation/recommendation stimulus.
analysis_plan.appropriate_reliance_definition: Accept correct stimuli and override/reject incorrect stimuli.
analysis_plan.style_analysis: Compare trust association with actual correctness, fluency and perceived confidence using participant-centered standardized regression plus Spearman summaries.
analysis_plan.expertise_analysis: Report calibration gap and over-trust by predeclared expertise group.
analysis_plan.order_analysis: Report trust-vs-order and response-time-vs-order Spearman associations.
analysis_plan.source_stage_analysis: Report descriptive trust and over-trust by Phase-15 source stage.
